x: G. Madhavan Nair (2003-09) is matched with Chandrayaan-1. Mangalyaan was under K. Radhakrishnan (2009-14), not A.S. Kiran Kumar; PSLV became operational in 1994 under K. Kasturirangan, not K. Sivan; and the 104-satellite PSLV launch (2017) was under A.S. Kiran Kumar, not K. Radhakrishnan.

s: Which of the following pairs of ISRO Chairman and landmark mission is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: A.S. Kiran Kumar – 104 satellites on one PSLV (2017)
x: K. Sivan (2018-22) saw Chandrayaan-2 and Mission Shakti; Chandrayaan-3 was under S. Somanath.

s: Who was ISRO Chairman (1972-84) when Aryabhata, Rohini and APPLE were launched?
x: Satish Dhawan headed ISRO from 1972 to 1984, the era of Aryabhata, SLV-3/Rohini and APPLE.

s: Mangalyaan (2014) was launched during the tenure of which ISRO Chairman?
x: K. Radhakrishnan (2009-14) led ISRO during Mangalyaan; Madhavan Nair led Chandrayaan-1.

s: Whom did Vikram Sarabhai succeed as head of the Atomic Energy Commission in 1966?
x: After Homi Bhabha's death, Sarabhai succeeded him at the Atomic Energy Commission in 1966.

s: Who became the first Indian woman to win the COSPAR Vikram Sarabhai Medal in 2026?
x: Annapurni Subramaniam won the 2026 COSPAR Vikram Sarabhai Medal, the 4th Indian and first Indian woman to do so.

s: Who is the current Chairman of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)?
x: Dr V. Narayanan, a former LPSC director, has been ISRO Chairman since 14 January 2025.

s: With Mangalyaan (2014), India became which country in the world to reach Mars orbit?
x: Mangalyaan reached Mars orbit on its maiden attempt, the first Asian mission, making India the fourth country to do so, not the third.

s: Which Indian mission became the first to land near the lunar south pole in 2023?
x: In 2023 Chandrayaan-3 achieved the first landing near the lunar south pole, while Aditya-L1 was sent to the L1 point.

s: In which year did India conduct Mission Shakti?
x: Mission Shakti was in 2019, after Chandrayaan-1 (2008) and Mangalyaan (2014), and before Chandrayaan-3 (2023).

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about recent Indian launch milestones?
o: LVM3-M6 carried BlueBird Block-2 on 24 December 2025.
SpaDeX made India the third country to demonstrate space docking.
Vikram-1 became the first privately developed Indian rocket to reach orbit on 18 July 2026.
x: SpaDeX made India the fourth docking nation, after the US, Russia and China.

s: Which launch vehicle carried BlueBird Block-2 (6,100 kg), the heaviest payload launched from Indian soil?
x: LVM3-M6 lifted BlueBird Block-2 on 24 December 2025, the heaviest payload from Indian soil.

s: In which year did Skyroot's Vikram-1 become the first privately developed Indian rocket to reach orbit?
x: Vikram-1 reached orbit on 18 July 2026.

s: With SpaDeX docking on 16 January 2025, India became which country to achieve space docking?
x: India became the 4th country, after the US, Russia and China, to dock in space.

s: In which year was Chandrayaan-1, India's first Moon mission, launched?
x: Chandrayaan-1 was launched in 2008, during G. Madhavan Nair's tenure.

s: Which mission went to the L1 point in 2023?
x: Aditya-L1 was sent to the L1 point in 2023, the same year as Chandrayaan-3.

s: On which launch vehicle was SpaDeX, the space docking demonstrator, launched on 30 December 2024?
x: SpaDeX's two small spacecraft were launched on PSLV-C60; docking was done on 16 January 2025.

s: In which year was NewSpace India Limited (NSIL) formed, the year of Mission Shakti and Chandrayaan-2?
x: NSIL was formed in 2019, the year of Mission Shakti and Chandrayaan-2.

s: Which was the first Indian-made sounding rocket, launched on 20 November 1967?
x: RH-75 was the first Indian-made sounding rocket; Nike-Apache (TERLS, 1963) was the first, American-built.

s: In which year was the Indian National Committee for Space Research (INCOSPAR) set up?
x: INCOSPAR came first in 1962; ISRO replaced it in 1969 and the Department of Space came in 1972.

s: Under which of the following did INCOSPAR, chaired by Vikram Sarabhai, function?
x: INCOSPAR was under the Department of Atomic Energy, not the Department of Space, which came only in 1972.

s: When was ISRO, which superseded INCOSPAR, established?
x: ISRO was formed on 15 August 1969 and superseded INCOSPAR (1962).

s:
Consider the following statements about the Department of Space:
1. It was created in 1972 along with the Space Commission.
2. ISRO was brought under it.
3. INCOSPAR was set up under it in 1962.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: DoS and the Space Commission came in 1972 and ISRO was brought under DoS; INCOSPAR was under the Department of Atomic Energy.

s: Which was the first sounding rocket launched from Thumba on 21 November 1963?
x: The American-built Nike-Apache was the first rocket from Thumba (1963); RH-75 (1967) was the first Indian-made sounding rocket.

s: TERLS at Thumba, Kerala, was chosen as a site because it lies close to which of the following?
x: Thumba lies close to the magnetic equator, suited to the study of the equatorial electrojet.

s: Where was India's Satellite Telecommunication Earth Station set up on 1 January 1967?
x: The Satellite Telecommunication Earth Station was set up at Ahmedabad on 1 January 1967.

s: When was the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) established?
x: ISRO was formed on 15 August 1969, not in November; 1 June 1972 is when it came under DoS.

s: INCOSPAR, set up by Homi Bhabha in 1962, had whom as its Chairman?
x: Vikram Sarabhai chaired INCOSPAR, which Homi Bhabha set up in 1962.

s: In which year did ISRO replace INCOSPAR?
x: ISRO replaced INCOSPAR on 15 August 1969; INCOSPAR was set up in 1962 and the DoS in 1972.

s: Shubhanshu Shukla flew to the International Space Station in June–July 2025 on which mission?
x: Shubhanshu Shukla flew to the ISS on Axiom-4 during June–July 2025.

s: Aboard which spacecraft did Rakesh Sharma, the first Indian in space, fly in April 1984?
x: Rakesh Sharma flew on the Soviet Soyuz T-11 on 3 April 1984.

s: Megha-Tropiques (2011) and SARAL (2013) came from India's space cooperation with which of the following?
x: Megha-Tropiques and SARAL, like APPLE on Ariane-1, are Indo-French cooperation milestones.

s: NISAR, launched in 2025, is a milestone of India's space cooperation with which of the following?
x: NISAR is an Indo-US mission, as was SITE with NASA in 1975-76.

s: Which Indian city hosted the 58th International Astronautical Congress in September 2007?
x: ISRO hosted the 58th IAC at Hyderabad in 2007; India's earlier IAC was at Bangalore in 1988.

s: Gaganyaan plans to carry a crew of three for three days to an orbit of about what height?
x: Gaganyaan plans a 3-member crew to a 400 km orbit for 3 days, ending in splashdown in Indian waters.

s: Which of the following is NOT among the next missions listed in the Indian Space Vision 2047 roadmap?
x: NISAR is an Indo-US mission launched in 2025; Chandrayaan-4, Chandrayaan-5 and the Venus Orbiter Mission are the roadmap's next missions.

s: By which year is the Bharatiya Antariksh Station targeted to be set up under India's Space Vision 2047?
x: The Bharatiya Antariksh Station is targeted by 2035. 2047 is the overall Vision horizon, not the station target; 2028 and 2030 are not the stated target years.

s: Who is the chairman of IN-SPACe?
x: Pawan Kumar Goenka is the IN-SPACe chairman; he says ISRO's role is 'by no means diminishing'.

s: What is the approved cost of India's Venus Orbiter Mission?
x: The Venus Orbiter Mission has been approved at Rs 1,236 crore.

s: Up to what level is FDI allowed in non-sensitive segments of India's space economy?
x: FDI up to 100% is allowed in non-sensitive space segments.

s: By which year does India aim to land an Indian astronaut on the Moon?
x: India targets the Bharatiya Antariksh Station by 2035 and an Indian landing on the Moon by 2040.

s:
Consider the following statements about India's space targets:
1. The Bharatiya Antariksh Station is targeted by 2035.
2. An Indian is to land on the Moon by 2047.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: The station is due by 2035; the crewed Moon landing target is 2040, not 2047.
